description:
I am a dedicated engineering counsellor based in Maharashtra, passionate about empowering students to achieve their academic and career goals in the field of engineering. With extensive experience in educational guidance, I specialize in helping students navigate the complex landscape of engineering admissions, entrance exams, college selection, and branch specialization.

My counselling approach is rooted in a deep understanding of current educational trends, industry requirements, and the unique needs of each student. I provide personalized career planning, support with application processes, and up-to-date information on top engineering colleges across India. My expertise spans JEE Main/Advanced, MH-CET, private university exams, and direct admissions, ensuring that students and parents receive accurate advice for both government and private institutions.

In addition to academic counselling, I guide students through the selection of suitable engineering streams and help them understand future prospects such as placements, internships, and further studies. I am committed to building confidence in students, clarifying doubts about career options, and helping them make well-informed decisions about their future.

Whether you are a student aspiring to pursue engineering, or a parent seeking clarity on higher education opportunities, I provide reliable support and mentorship at every stage—turning aspirations into realities through effective guidance and genuine care.
